tender.title: Public Affairs and Crisis Communication Support
tender.description:
The Port of Milford Haven is seeking to appoint an experienced agency partner to provide strategic public affairs and crisis communications support.
The full suite of Tender documents can be accessed via the link: https://mhpa.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/O365Tenders/IgBN5pSvUGxhTbiYCnAvbmmAAWfZDm3r6veUcMeq0Yber_E?e=1qNlFA

procedure.features:
The procurement will comprise the following stages: 
Assessment of mandatory pass/fail requirements. 
Evaluation of written quality submissions. 
Evaluation of commercial submissions. 
Following evaluation of the written quality and commercial submissions, PoMH may shortlist Tenderers to participate in the Presentation Stage. Shortlisting will be based on the interim evaluation scores achieved during the written quality and commercial evaluation stages.
Presentation interviews with shortlisted Tenderers.

tender.submissionMethodDetails:
Please submit tenders via Sell2wales post-box
https://www.sell2wales.gov.wales/

criteria.name: Written Quality Evaluation
criteria.description: Evaluation of the Tenderer's written response to the quality questions, including understanding of the Port's requirements, service delivery approach, relevant experience, crisis communications capability, delivery team, contract management and social value.

criteria.name: Commercial Submission
criteria.description: Evaluation of the Tenderer's Commercial Return, including Essential Services, Optional Call-Off Services and applicable resource rates, in accordance with the Commercial Evaluation Methodology set out in the ITT.

criteria.name: Presentation Stage
criteria.description: Evaluation of the Tenderer's presentation, including understanding of the Port of Milford Haven, proposed approach, key personnel, strategic thinking, crisis communications capability, cultural fit and responses to questions raised by the evaluation panel.

tender.title: UBIQUITY FPV Training
tender.description: Procurement of a scalable, affordable, non-energetic FPV training capability to deliver increased training mass under the RAPSTONE programme. A competitive procurement will be used to test the market and secure value for money, taking account of current technology, supplier capacity and support solutions. Final quantities will be determined through competition, with lessons identified from FPV Tranches 1 and 2 informing the final User Requirement Document. This represents the final planned FPV training tranche under the current UBIQUITY approach and is distinct from the operational Armed FPV capability requirement.

criteria.name: Technical Assessment
criteria.description:
Tenderers shall provide sufficient information and evidence to enable the Authority to assess their responses against each criterion. Responses will be scored in accordance with the evaluation methodology
Following completion of Stage 1, the three highest-scoring Tenderers will be shortlisted and invited to participate in Stage 2 Demonstration Phase.
The Authority reserves the right to invite fewer than three Tenderers where fewer than three acceptable Tender Responses are received.
Shortlisted Tenderers shall be required to provide demonstration equipment and participate in a practical evaluation event.
The purpose of the demonstration is to validate the claims made within the written Tender Response and assess the suitability of the proposed FPV training drone solution in a realistic training environment.

criteria.name: Commercial  Assessment
criteria.description:
The Authority has an available budget of £3,750,000 inclusive of VAT for the initial purchase and delivery of FPV Training Drone systems and associated support requirements under this Contract.
Tenderers shall submit a proposal identifying the maximum number of complete FPV Training Drone sets that can be supplied within this budget.
In addition, Tenderers shall provide a firm fixed price for the purchase of additional compliant Sets beyond those offered within the available budget. The Authority will separately assess the cost of additional Sets as part of the commercial evaluation to determine value for money and potential future scalability.
